name: The Sea Ranch (cypress hedgerows on the Sonoma marine terrace)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). The Sea Ranch Golf Links, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data) and NAIP: lush, cool fog-coast turf; long green meadow grass with blonde tips in the rough (F0-F2); the dark duff under the cypress hedgerows (G0-G2: woods); the terrace's blonde coastal meadow out of bounds (L0-L2); greyish cream sand; the grey-blue Pacific and dark headland rock. Trees in assets-src/trees_sea_ranch.py: Monterey cypress, bishop pine and redwood. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
